item.title: Elev8 Energy Announces 2025 Revenue Milestone and Chicago Roofing Expansion
item.description: Elev8 Energy reports more than $30.3 million in residential project revenue generated by its field in 2025 and confirms a Chicago expansion into roofing in early 2026. The company said the milestone reflects continued demand across its solar sales and project management operations.
